neighbours.label: the verb or 'to' that opens a recommended action in advice or instructions ('consider these steps', 'urged them to', 'make sure that you')
fire: Before you sign the lease, consider these points about the deposit.
The minister urged companies to invest more in local training.
When filling in the form, make sure that you list every address.
Factors to consider include cost, distance and the size of the garden.
Doctors advised patients to drink more water during the heatwave.
Scroll down the page and consider the options for each plan.
It is the duty of each employee to report unsafe equipment.
The coach encouraged the players to rest before the final.
quiet: Before you signed the lease, the agent explained the deposit.
The minister said companies invested more in local training last year.
When the form arrived, every address was already listed.
The garden was large, distant and expensive to maintain.
Doctors noticed that patients drank more water during the heatwave.
The page lists the options for each plan in a table.
Each employee reported unsafe equipment last month.
The players rested before the final after a long week.
